    # =========================================================
    # Repaired protocol: sample transfer + reagent addition
    # Fixes applied:
    #   - All aspirate/dispense volumes kept within the 50 uL
    #     tip capacity (prevents over-aspiration warnings)
    #   - Fresh tips picked up before every liquid transfer and
    #     explicitly dropped back to the tip rack afterwards
    #   - All hardware operations properly awaited
    # =========================================================

    # --- Get pre-configured resources ---
    tip_rack = lh.get_resource("tip_rack_50ul")
    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Protocol parameters ---
    # 50 uL tips: keep every aspiration safely below tip capacity
    sample_vol = 40      # uL of sample transferred per well
    reagent_vol = 30     # uL of reagent added per well
    sample_wells = ["A1", "B1", "C1", "D1"]

    # Fresh tip column per sample transfer (avoids cross-contamination)
    tip_positions = ["A1", "A2", "A3", "A4"]

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 1: Transfer samples from source to destination plate
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    for sample_well, tip_pos in zip(sample_wells, tip_positions):
        # Pick up a fresh set of tips
        await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])

        # Aspirate sample from the source plate
        await lh.aspirate(source_plate[sample_well], vols=[sample_vol])

        # Dispense into the matching destination well
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[sample_well], vols=[sample_vol])

        # Drop tips back to their original tip rack position
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    # Step 2: Add reagent to each destination well
    # (same reagent -> same tips can be reused across wells)
    # ---------------------------------------------------------
    await lh.pick_up_tips(tip_rack["A5"])

    for sample_well in sample_wells:
        # Aspirate reagent from the first trough channel
        await lh.aspirate(reagent_trough["A1"], vols=[reagent_vol])

        # Dispense reagent into the destination well
        # (well now holds 40 + 30 = 70 uL, well within 1 mL capacity)
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[sample_well], vols=[reagent_vol])

    # Return reagent tips to the rack
    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A5"])

    print("--- PROTOCOL_SUCCESS ---")

    source_plate = lh.get_resource("source_plate")
    destination_plate = lh.get_resource("destination_plate")
    reagent_trough = lh.get_resource("reagent_trough")

    # --- Protocol parameters ---

    sample_vol = 40      # uL of sample transferred per well

        # Aspirate sample from the source plate
        await lh.aspirate(source_plate[sample_well], vols=[sample_vol])

        # Dispense into the matching destination well
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[sample_well], vols=[sample_vol])

        # Drop tips back to their original tip rack position
        await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack[tip_pos])

    # ---------------------------------------------------------

        # Dispense reagent into the destination well
        # (well now holds 40 + 30 = 70 uL, well within 1 mL capacity)
        await lh.dispense(destination_plate[sample_well], vols=[reagent_vol])

    await lh.drop_tips(tip_rack["A5"])
